goal: Improve the app-first Allosaurus candidate by strengthening the visible hand/claw cue without changing the full-body scene, tail, stance, or longer forelimb read.

stillUnderReview: close paleontology review of hand and toe shapes
rejectIf: changed body, head, legs, tail, or background

experiments.finding: Rejected before app promotion. The stronger version made the added fingers read as thin hanging strings or extra appendages, while the conservative version was too subtle to justify a first-image change.

Selected as an incremental count-level improvement. It preserves the full-body scene and slightly clarifies the visible hand/claw separation. Higher denoise outputs over-smoothed or over-emphasized the hand.

decision.status: accepted as app-first incremental candidate, not final approval
decision.reason: The selected low-denoise hand-only inpaint improves the current first image without introducing obvious limb-count errors. Exact three-finger anatomy and rear-foot detail remain under review.
